profile.summary: Currently working as a software engineer at GitHub.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Development, 3M Corporate Research Process Lab

Developed edge-based computing systems that provide near real-time feedback to improve the research & manufacturing processes of new and existing 3M products.

- Deployed a graphical monitoring system for near real-time data using ReactJS and a Python back-end.
- Created automated tools for deploying machine learning models to edge computing systems using Azure Machine Learning.
- Implemented CI/CD tools and pipelines to deploy to production edge systems.

Primary technical skills used in this role:
ReactJS, Javascript, Docker, C#, Python, SQL, MongoDB, Azure, Azure IotEdge Azure DevOps, AWS, Drone CI, Scrum

positions.title: Web Platform Technical Analyst
positions.description:
Software Development, IT

Developed enhancements for and maintained the backend systems serving 3M's consumer facing product catalog on 3M.com.

- Designed and deployed a new 3M.com federated search experience that brought together web, product, and safety documentation results to users in a single location.
- Maintained customer facing websites for 3M businesses across the globe.
- Trained new and existing developers on coding best practices including code reviews and the importance of integration and unit testing.

Primary technical skills/technologies used in this role:
Java, SQL, JBoss, Endeca, Scrum

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description:
Software Development
IT

Participated in 3M's Summer IT internship program as a part of the IT Lab Collaboration group creating software solutions that improve technical collaborations within 3M's R&D labs.

- Designed and implemented a replacement data transfer program for managing 3M technical documents.
- Migrated legacy data migration tools from Visual Basic to Java to enable their use with 3M's internal search tools.
- Researched and proposed end-user reporting tools for use with incident management data and performed voice of customer surveys to establish user expectations and requirements.

Primary technical skills/technologies used in this role:
Java, SQL, Visual Basic

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Participated in Hope College's computer science undergraduate research program creating educational lab exercises teaching topics related to computer security. Work was done under the guidance of Dr. Micheal Jipping.

- Created lab exercises that contained step-by-step instructions demonstrating and teaching computer security topics in an interactive fashion. 
- Wrote exercises on SQL injection and the development of computer viruses.
- Collaborated with two other students, assisting with the creation and review of exercises covering man-in-the-middle attacks, buffer overflows, password-cracking, and social engineering. 
- Hosted a workshop based on our research at the March 2013 SIGCSE conference in Denver, Colorado.

positions.title: Researcher
positions.description:
Participated in Hope College's computer science undergraduate research program creating an Android application to assist the severely visually impaired. Work was done under the guidance of Dr. Micheal Jipping and Dr. Ryan McFall.

- Wrote an Android mobile application that used the device's built in camera and optical character recognition to digitize real world text.
- Worked directly with a user to gather feedback on UI and create a custom camera interface that met their accessibility needs.
- Implemented features that allowed users to manipulate the digitized text to their needs or have it read aloud via text-to-speech.
